SOURCE tools/decomp/mutate.py
SHA256 b6aff34c426059ecc2a57bc3783b0bfdd0e29c6ff59c2f7af4b1d29a7f0f8771

0001: #!/usr/bin/env python3
0002: """Mutation check of the generated differential self-tests.
0003: 
0004:     python3 tools/decomp/mutate.py                 # every function with a passing autotest
0005:     python3 tools/decomp/mutate.py 0x988020 ...    # chosen functions (original addresses)
0006: 
0007: A passing autotest says the decompiled function behaves like the original on
0008: the generated inputs; it does not say the inputs reach the function's
0009: branches. This tool plants small faults in a copy of decomp/src (flipped
0010: comparisons and logic operators, +/- swaps, literal + 1, removed `!`, removed
0011: statements) and checks that the test notices them.
0012: 
0013: Mutants that do not compile, or compile to the same code as the original
0014: function, are dropped. The rest run in rounds: one mutant per function per
0015: round, never two in a round when one function's test can reach the other's
0016: changed code. A test is strong when it kills enough of its mutants; the
0017: result goes to build-decomp/mutation.json.
0018: """
0019: from __future__ import annotations
0020: 
0021: import argparse
0022: from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
0023: import json
0024: import os
0025: from pathlib import Path
0026: import random
0027: import re
0028: import shutil
0029: import subprocess
0030: import sys
0031: 
0032: sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
0033: import autotest  # noqa: E402
0034: import elfdb  # noqa: E402
0035: import evidence  # noqa: E402
0036: import ghidra_cpp  # noqa: E402
0037: import hybrid  # noqa: E402
0038: import objdiff  # noqa: E402
0039: import toolchain  # noqa: E402
0040: 
0041: ROOT = elfdb.ROOT
0042: SRC = ROOT / "decomp" / "src"
0043: WORK = ROOT / "build-decomp" / "mutate"
0044: RESULT = ROOT / "build-decomp" / "mutation.json"
0045: ACCEPTED = ROOT / "decomp" / "autotests.json"
0046: MAX_MUTANTS = 10
0047: PROBES = 24
0048: STRONG = 0.8
0049: MIN_MUTANTS = 3
0050: MIN_CLASSES = 2
0051: 
0052: # "Type name = ...;", "Type* name;", "std::wstring name(...);" (removing one only breaks the build).
0053: DECLARATION = re.compile(r"(?!(?:delete|throw|goto|case|else)\b)(?:[A-Za-z_][\w:<>,]*(?:\s*[*&]+\s*|\s+))+"
0054:                          r"[A-Za-z_]\w*\s*(?:=|;|\(|\[)")
0055: OPERATORS = [(" < ", " <= "), (" <= ", " < "), (" > ", " >= "), (" >= ", " > "),
0056:              (" == ", " != "), (" != ", " == "), (" && ", " || "), (" || ", " && "),
0057:              (" + ", " - "), (" - ", " + "), (" += ", " -= "), (" -= ", " += "),
0058:              ("++", "--"), ("--", "++")]
0059: 
0060: 
0061: # -- source -------------------------------------------------------------------
0062: def mask(text):
0063:     """Text with comments and string/char literals blanked (offsets kept)."""
0064:     out = list(text)
0065: 
0066:     def blank(i, j):
0067:         for k in range(i, j):
0068:             if out[k] != "\n":
0069:                 out[k] = " "
0070: 
0071:     i, n = 0, len(text)
0072:     while i < n:
0073:         if text.startswith("//", i):
0074:             j = text.find("\n", i)
0075:             j = n if j < 0 else j
0076:             blank(i, j)
0077:             i = j
0078:         elif text.startswith("/*", i):
0079:             j = text.find("*/", i + 2)
0080:             j = n if j < 0 else j + 2
0081:             blank(i, j)
0082:             i = j
0083:         elif text[i] in "\"'":
0084:             j = i + 1
0085:             while j < n and text[j] not in (text[i], "\n"):
0086:                 j += 2 if text[j] == "\\" else 1
0087:             blank(i + 1, j)
0088:             i = j + 1
0089:         else:
0090:             i += 1
0091:     return "".join(out)
0092: 
0093: 
0094: def matching(text, at, open_, close):
0095:     depth = 0
0096:     for i in range(at, len(text)):
0097:         if text[i] == open_:
0098:             depth += 1
0099:         elif text[i] == close:
0100:             depth -= 1
0101:             if depth == 0:
0102:                 return i
0103:     return -1
0104: 
0105: 
0106: def canonical_parameter(parameter, named=False):
0107:     """Conservative spelling normalization for ordinary C++ parameter types.
0108: 
0109:     Used only to disambiguate same-arity overloads. Complex declarators or
0110:     unresolved aliases remain unmatched rather than selecting another body.
0111:     """
0112:     p = parameter.strip()
0113:     p = p.replace(autotest.WSTRING, "std::wstring")
0114:     if named:
0115:         p = re.sub(r"\s*=.*$", "", p)
0116:         # Strip a name only after a pointer/reference or a separated type.
0117:         m = re.search(r"([*&]\s*|\s+)([A-Za-z_]\w*)$", p)
0118:         if m and m.group(2) not in {"int", "long", "short", "char", "double", "float", "const", "volatile", "unsigned", "signed"}:
0119:             p = p[:m.start(2)].strip()
0120:     p = re.sub(r"^(.+?)\s+const\s*([*&].*)$", r"const \1\2", p)
0121:     return re.sub(r"\s+", "", p)
0122: 
0123: 
0124: def definition(text, masked, f):
0125:     """(body start, body end) of f's definition in a TU source, or None."""
0126:     qual = f["demangled"].split("(")[0]
0127:     want = len([p for p in ghidra_cpp.split_args(f.get("params") or "") if p != "void"])
0128:     found = []
0129:     wanted_types = [canonical_parameter(p) for p in ghidra_cpp.split_args(f.get("params") or "") if p != "void"]
0130:     for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^[\w:<>,*&\s]*?" + re.escape(qual) + r"\s*\(", masked):
0131:         close = matching(masked, m.end() - 1, "(", ")")
0132:         brace, semi = masked.find("{", close), masked.find(";", close)
0133:         if close < 0 or brace < 0 or (0 <= semi < brace):
0134:             continue
0135:         suffix = " ".join(masked[close + 1:brace].strip().split())
0136:         if f.get("kind") == "ctor" and suffix.startswith(":"):
0137:             suffix = ""  # member/base initializer list follows the parameter list
0138:         if suffix != ghidra_cpp.cv_suffix(f).strip():
0139:             continue
0140:         params = masked[m.end():close].strip()
0141:         count = 0 if params in ("", "void") else len(ghidra_cpp.split_args(params))
0142:         types = [canonical_parameter(p, named=True) for p in ghidra_cpp.split_args(params) if p and p != "void"]
0143:         found.append((count, brace, matching(masked, brace, "{", "}"), types))
0144:     exact = [x for x in found if x[0] == want]
0145:     if len(exact) != 1:
0146:         exact = [x for x in exact if x[3] == wanted_types]
0147:     if len(exact) != 1:
0148:         return None
0149:     return exact[0][1], exact[0][2]
0150: 
0151: 
0152: def mutation_points(text, masked, start, end):
0153:     points = []
0154:     body = masked[start:end]
0155:     for old, new in OPERATORS:
0156:         for m in re.finditer(re.escape(old), body):
0157:             points.append((start + m.start(), start + m.end(), new))
0158:     for m in re.finditer(r"!(?!=)", body):
0159:         points.append((start + m.start(), start + m.end(), ""))
0160:     for m in re.finditer(r"(?<![\w.])(\d+)(?![\w.])", body):
0161:         points.append((start + m.start(), start + m.end(), str(int(m.group(1)) + 1)))
0162:     for m in re.finditer(r"\b(true|false)\b", body):
0163:         points.append((start + m.start(), start + m.end(), "false" if m.group(1) == "true" else "true"))
0164:     for m in re.finditer(r"(?m)^[ \t]*([^\s{}][^\n{}]*;)[ \t]*$", body):
0165:         statement = m.group(1)
0166:         if re.match(r"(return|break|continue)\b", statement) or DECLARATION.match(statement):
0167:             continue
0168:         points.append((start + m.start(1), start + m.end(1), ";"))
0169:     return points
0170: 
0171: 
0172: def code_digests(db, functions):
0173:     """Instruction-similarity keys, retained for diagnostic callers only."""
0174:     return {address: row["code"] for address, row in compiled_evidence(db, functions).items()}
0175: 
0176: 
0177: def compiled_evidence(db, functions):
0178:     """Full TU objects, including data/EH/relocations, not just instructions."""
0179:     original = objdiff.Original(db=db)
0180:     names = {t["id"]: t["name"] for t in db["tus"]}
0181:     sources = {p.name: p for p in SRC.rglob("*.cpp")}
0182:     out = {}
0183:     for tu in sorted({names[f["tu"]] for f in functions if names.get(f["tu"]) in sources}):
0184:         unit = objdiff.compare_source(sources[tu], original, quiet=True)
0185:         for row in unit["functions"]:
0186:             if row.get("code") and row.get("address") and not row.get("weak"):
0187:                 out[row["address"]] = {"code": row["code"], "object_digest": row.get("object_digest")}
0188:     return out
0189: 
0190: 
0191: def load_accepted():
0192:     return json.loads(ACCEPTED.read_text()) if ACCEPTED.exists() else {}
0193: 
0194: 
0195: def record(db, functions, results):
0196:     """Publish only evidence still bound to the inputs actually tested."""
0197:     accepted = load_accepted()
0198:     versioned = [f for f in functions if (results.get(f["address"], {}).get("evidence") or {}).get("schema") == evidence.SCHEMA]
0199:     inputs = evidence.input_digest(db) if versioned else None
0200:     builds = compiled_evidence(db, versioned) if versioned else {}
0201:     if versioned and evidence.input_digest(db) != inputs:
0202:         raise SystemExit("inputs changed while recording mutation evidence; rerun the check")
0203:     for f in functions:
0204:         r = results.get(f["address"], {})
0205:         build = builds.get(f["address"], {})
0206:         fresh = evidence.current(r, build.get("object_digest"), inputs)
0207:         generated = (r.get("evidence") or {}).get("parameters", {}).get("hand") is False
0208:         if (r.get("strong") and mutation_strength(r.get("mutants", [])) and fresh and generated
0209:                 and r.get("code_at_test") == build.get("code")):
0210:             accepted[f["address"]] = {"name": f["demangled"], "killed": r["killed"], "tried": r["tried"],
0211:                                       "code": r["code_at_test"], "evidence": r["evidence"]}
0212:         else:
0213:             if r.get("strong"):
0214:                 print(f"stale mutation evidence: {f['address']}; rerun it on the current inputs")
0215:             accepted.pop(f["address"], None)
0216:     ACCEPTED.write_text(json.dumps(dict(sorted(accepted.items())), indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
0217:     print(f"{ACCEPTED.relative_to(ROOT)}: {len(accepted)} functions")
0218: 
0219: 
0220: def describe(text, point):
0221:     a, b, new = point
0222:     line = text.count("\n", 0, a) + 1
0223:     return f"line {line}: '{text[a:b].strip()}' -> '{new.strip()}'"
0224: 
0225: 
0226: # -- assembly -----------------------------------------------------------------
0227: def functions_in_asm(text):
0228:     """Normalized body of every function in a GCC .s file (local labels renamed,
0229:     referenced .LC constants inlined)."""
0230:     lines = text.splitlines()
0231:     data, current = {}, None
0232:     for line in lines:
0233:         m = re.match(r"^(\.LC\d+):$", line)
0234:         if m:
0235:             current = m.group(1)
0236:             data[current] = []
0237:         elif current and (re.match(r"^\S+:$", line) or line.strip().startswith((".section", ".text"))):
0238:             current = None
0239:         elif current:
0240:             data[current].append(line.strip())
0241:     names = set(re.findall(r"\.type\s+([^,\s]+),\s*@function", text))
0242:     out, name, body = {}, None, []
0243:     for line in lines:
0244:         if name is None:
0245:             m = re.match(r"^([^\s:]+):$", line)
0246:             if m and m.group(1) in names:
0247:                 name, body = m.group(1), []
0248:             continue
0249:         if re.match(rf"^\s*\.size\s+{re.escape(name)},", line):
0250:             labels = {}
0251: 
0252:             def rename(m):
0253:                 tok = m.group(0)
0254:                 if tok in data:
0255:                     return "<" + ";".join(data[tok]) + ">"
0256:                 return labels.setdefault(tok, f".L#{len(labels)}")
0257:             out[name] = "\n".join(re.sub(r"\.L\w+", rename, l) for l in body)
0258:             name = None
0259:         else:
0260:             body.append(line)
0261:     return out
0262: 
0263: 
0264: def references(asm_functions, known):
0265:     """Function -> functions of ours it calls or takes the address of."""
0266:     return {name: {t for t in re.findall(r"[\w.$@]+", body) if t in known and t != name}
0267:             for name, body in asm_functions.items()}
0268: 
0269: 
0270: # -- the run ------------------------------------------------------------------
0271: class Mutant:
0272:     def __init__(self, target, point, text):
0273:         self.target, self.point, self.what = target, point, describe(text, point)
0274:         old, new = text[point[0]:point[1]].strip(), point[2].strip()
0275:         self.category = ("statement" if new == ";" else "constant" if old.isdigit() else
0276:                          "boolean" if old in ("true", "false", "!") else
0277:                          "comparison" if old in ("<", "<=", ">", ">=", "==", "!=") else
0278:                          "logical" if old in ("&&", "||") else "arithmetic")
0279:         self.affected = set()
0280: 
0281: 
0282: def mutation_strength(rows):
0283:     tried = [r for r in rows if r.get("outcome") in ("killed", "survived")]
0284:     classes = {r.get("category") for r in tried if r.get("category")}
0285:     killed = sum(r["outcome"] == "killed" and r.get("isolated") is True for r in tried)
0286:     return len(tried) >= MIN_MUTANTS and len(classes) >= MIN_CLASSES and killed / len(tried) >= STRONG
0287: 
0288: 
0289: def probe(source, text, mutant, baseline, slot):
0290:     """Compiles the mutated TU; fills mutant.affected, False when invalid or equivalent."""
0291:     a, b, new = mutant.point
0292:     path = WORK / "probe" / str(slot) / source.name
0293:     path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
0294:     path.write_text(text[:a] + new + text[b:])
0295:     try:
0296:         toolchain.compile_source(path, path.with_suffix(".s"), ["-I", str(hybrid.HYBRID)], assembly=True, quiet=True)
0297:     except SystemExit:
0298:         return False
0299:     after = functions_in_asm(path.with_suffix(".s").read_text())
0300:     mutant.affected = {n for n in set(after) | set(baseline) if after.get(n) != baseline.get(n)}
0301:     return bool(mutant.affected & set(mutant.target["names"]))
0302: 
0303: 
0304: def stats(report):
0305:     out = {}
0306:     for line in report:
0307:         m = re.match(r"\s*stats (\S+) same (\d+) both-failed (\d+) different (\d+)(?: incomplete (\d+))?", line)
0308:         if m:
0309:             out[m.group(1)] = tuple(int(x or 0) for x in m.groups()[1:])
0310:     return out
0311: 
0312: 
0313: def generated_outcome(value):
0314:     if value is None or value[3]:
0315:         return "error"
0316:     if value[2]:
0317:         return "killed"
0318:     return "survived" if value[0] >= autotest.MIN_COMPLETED else "error"
0319: 
0320: 
0321: def verdicts(report):
0322:     """Test name -> passed, from the loader's PASS/FAIL lines."""
0323:     out = {}
0324:     for line in report:
0325:         m = re.match(r"tlhybrid: (\S+)\s+(PASS|FAIL) \(", line)
0326:         if m:
0327:             out[m.group(1)] = m.group(2) == "PASS"
0328:     return out
0329: 
0330: 
0331: def build_and_test(src, tests, names, out):
0332:     os.environ["OTL_SELFTEST_TIMEOUT"] = str(60 + 12 * len(names))
0333:     blob, loader = hybrid.build(out=out, verbose=False, src=src, tests=tests)
0334:     try:
0335:         code, report = hybrid.selftest(blob, loader, only=",".join(sorted(set(names))))
0336:     except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
0337:         return {}, []  # incomplete process output cannot establish a mutant kill
0338:     if code not in (0, 1):
0339:         return {}, []
0340:     return stats(report), report
0341: 
0342: 
0343: def hand_coverage(db):
0344:     """Function address -> names of the hand-written tests whose file declares it with TL_ORIGINAL."""
0345:     out = {}
0346:     by_name = {}
0347:     for a, f in db["functions"].items():
0348:         for n in f["names"]:
0349:             by_name[n] = a
0350:     for test in sorted(hybrid.TESTS.glob("*.cpp")):
0351:         text = test.read_text(errors="replace")
0352:         names = re.findall(r"^TL_TEST\((\w+)\)", text, re.M)
0353:         for mangled in re.findall(r'TL_ORIGINAL\([^;]*?"(_Z\w+)"\)', text, re.S):
0354:             if mangled in by_name:
0355:                 out.setdefault(by_name[mangled], set()).update(names)
0356:     return out
0357: 
0358: 
0359: def main():
0360:     parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
0361:     parser.add_argument("addresses", nargs="*")
0362:     parser.add_argument("--max", type=int, default=MAX_MUTANTS, help="mutants per function")
0363:     parser.add_argument("--accept", action="store_true",
0364:                         help=f"record strong tests in {ACCEPTED.relative_to(ROOT)} (check.py accepts them)")
0365:     parser.add_argument("--hand", action="store_true",
0366:                         help="check the hand-written tests in decomp/hybrid/tests (TL_ORIGINAL) instead of "
0367:                              "generated ones; addresses default to every DIFF function they cover")
0368:     parser.add_argument("--record", action="store_true",
0369:                         help=f"only record the last run ({RESULT.relative_to(ROOT)}) in {ACCEPTED.relative_to(ROOT)}")
0370:     args = parser.parse_args()
0371:     if args.record:
0372:         db = elfdb.load_db()
0373:         results = json.loads(RESULT.read_text())
0374:         return record(db, [db["functions"][a] for a in results if "tried" in results[a]], results)
0375:     shutil.rmtree(WORK, ignore_errors=True)
0376:     WORK.mkdir(parents=True)
0377:     toolchain.CC_CACHE = WORK / "cc-cache"  # mutated sources would only litter the shared cache
0378:     base = {}
0379: 
0380:     if args.hand:
0381:         db = elfdb.load_db()
0382:         coverage = hand_coverage(db)
0383:         functions = ([db["functions"][hex(int(a, 16))] for a in args.addresses] if args.addresses
0384:                      else [f for f in autotest.diff_functions(db) if f["address"] in coverage])
0385:         functions = [f for f in {f["address"]: f for f in functions}.values() if f["address"] in coverage]
0386:         tests = sorted(hybrid.TESTS.glob("*.cpp"))
0387:         covering = lambda f: sorted(coverage[f["address"]])  # noqa: E731
0388:         print(f"baseline: {len(functions)} functions under hand-written tests")
0389:         tested_inputs = evidence.input_digest(db)
0390:         tested_builds = compiled_evidence(db, functions)
0391:         _, report = build_and_test(SRC, tests, [n for f in functions for n in covering(f)], WORK / "base")
0392:         passed = verdicts(report)
0393:         targets = [f for f in functions if all(passed.get(n) for n in covering(f))]
0394:         print(f"  {len(targets)} with passing tests")
0395:     else:
0396:         gen = autotest.Generator()
0397:         db = gen.db
0398:         functions = ([db["functions"][hex(int(a, 16))] for a in args.addresses] if args.addresses
0399:                      else autotest.diff_functions(db))
0400:         functions = list({f["address"]: f for f in functions}.values())
0401:         made, _ = gen.write(functions)
0402:         tests = sorted(autotest.OUT.glob("*.cpp"))
0403:         covering = lambda f: [f"auto_{f['address'][2:]}"]  # noqa: E731
0404:         print(f"baseline: {len(made)} autotests")
0405:         tested_inputs = evidence.input_digest(db)
0406:         tested_builds = compiled_evidence(db, made)
0407:         base, report = build_and_test(SRC, tests, [n for f in made for n in covering(f)], WORK / "base")
0408:         targets = [f for f in made if covering(f)[0] in base and base[covering(f)[0]][2] == 0
0409:                    and base[covering(f)[0]][3] == 0
0410:                    and base[covering(f)[0]][0] >= autotest.MIN_COMPLETED]
0411:         print(f"  {len(targets)} pass with at least {autotest.MIN_COMPLETED} completed cases")
0412: 
0413:     if evidence.input_digest(db) != tested_inputs:
0414:         raise SystemExit("inputs changed during baseline testing; rerun on a stable snapshot")
0415:     parameters = {"max_mutants": args.max, "probes": PROBES, "strong_threshold": STRONG,
0416:                   "min_mutants": MIN_MUTANTS, "min_classes": MIN_CLASSES,
0417:                   "cases": autotest.CASES, "min_completed": autotest.MIN_COMPLETED,
0418:                   "budget_seconds": autotest.BUDGET_SECONDS, "hand": args.hand}
0419: 
0420:     # Our functions, their code and what they reach.
0421:     tu_names = {t["id"]: t["name"] for t in db["tus"]}
0422:     sources = {p.name: p for p in SRC.rglob("*.cpp")}
0423:     asm = {}
0424:     for name in sources:
0425:         s = WORK / "base" / f"{Path(name).stem}.s"
0426:         asm[name] = functions_in_asm(s.read_text()) if s.exists() else {}
0427:     known = {n for funcs in asm.values() for n in funcs}
0428:     calls = {}
0429:     for funcs in asm.values():
0430:         calls.update(references(funcs, known))
0431: 
0432:     def reach(f):
0433:         seen, todo = set(), [n for n in f["names"] if n in known]
0434:         while todo:
0435:             n = todo.pop()
0436:             if n not in seen:
0437:                 seen.add(n)
0438:                 todo += calls.get(n, ())
0439:         return seen
0440: 
0441:     # Candidate mutants per target, compiled in parallel.
0442:     queues, results = {}, {}
0443:     jobs = []
0444:     for f in targets:
0445:         source = sources.get(tu_names.get(f["tu"], ""))
0446:         if not source:
0447:             results[f["address"]] = {"error": "no source"}
0448:             continue
0449:         text = source.read_text()
0450:         masked = mask(text)
0451:         span = definition(text, masked, f)
0452:         if not span:
0453:             results[f["address"]] = {"error": "definition not found"}
0454:             continue
0455:         points = mutation_points(text, masked, *span)
0456:         random.Random(int(f["address"], 16)).shuffle(points)
0457:         for p in points[:PROBES]:
0458:             jobs.append((f, source, text, Mutant(f, p, text)))
0459:     print(f"probing {len(jobs)} candidate mutants")
0460:     with ThreadPoolExecutor(4) as pool:
0461:         valid = list(pool.map(lambda j: probe(j[1], j[2], j[3], asm[j[1].name], id(j[3])), jobs))
0462:     for (f, source, text, m), ok in zip(jobs, valid):
0463:         q = queues.setdefault(f["address"], [])
0464:         if ok and len(q) < args.max:
0465:             m.source, m.reach = source, None
0466:             q.append(m)
0467:     reaches = {f["address"]: reach(f) for f in targets}
0468: 
0469:     # Rounds.
0470:     done = {a: [] for a in queues}
0471:     round_no = 0
0472:     while any(queues.values()):
0473:         round_no += 1
0474:         chosen = []
0475:         for address, q in queues.items():
0476:             if not q or (chosen and getattr(q[0], "alone", False)):
0477:                 continue
0478:             m = q[0]
0479:             # One mutant per test: a failure must point at a single mutant.
0480:             if all(not (reaches[address] & c.affected) and not (reaches[c.target["address"]] & m.affected)
0481:                    and not set(covering(m.target)) & set(covering(c.target)) for c in chosen):
0482:                 chosen.append(q.pop(0))
0483:                 if getattr(m, "alone", False):
0484:                     break
0485:         src = WORK / "src"
0486:         shutil.rmtree(src, ignore_errors=True)
0487:         shutil.copytree(SRC, src)
0488:         by_file = {}
0489:         for m in chosen:
0490:             by_file.setdefault(m.source.relative_to(SRC), []).append(m)
0491:         for rel, ms in by_file.items():
0492:             text = (SRC / rel).read_text()
0493:             for m in sorted(ms, key=lambda m: -m.point[0]):
0494:                 a, b, new = m.point
0495:                 text = text[:a] + new + text[b:]
0496:             (src / rel).write_text(text)
0497:         try:
0498:             got, report = build_and_test(src, tests, [n for m in chosen for n in covering(m.target)], WORK / "round")
0499:         except SystemExit as error:
0500:             got, report = {}, []
0501:             print(f"  round {round_no}: build failed: {error}")
0502:         passed = verdicts(report)
0503:         for m in chosen:
0504:             names = covering(m.target)
0505:             if args.hand:
0506:                 s = None
0507:                 if any(n not in passed for n in names):
0508:                     # The run died (a crash outside a forked child): retry the mutant alone.
0509:                     if len(chosen) > 1 and not getattr(m, "alone", False):
0510:                         m.alone = True
0511:                         queues[m.target["address"]].insert(0, m)
0512:                         continue
0513:                     outcome = "killed" if report else "error"
0514:                 else:
0515:                     outcome = "survived" if all(passed[n] for n in names) else "killed"
0516:             else:
0517:                 s = got.get(names[0])
0518:                 outcome = generated_outcome(s)
0519:             # Symbol scans cannot prove independence through indirect calls.
0520:             # Batch discoveries are cheap candidates; only an isolated kill is evidence.
0521:             if outcome == "killed" and len(chosen) > 1:
0522:                 m.alone = True
0523:                 queues[m.target["address"]].insert(0, m)
0524:                 continue
0525:             done[m.target["address"]].append({"mutant": m.what, "outcome": outcome, "stats": s,
0526:                                                "isolated": len(chosen) == 1, "category": m.category})
0527:         print(f"round {round_no}: {len(chosen)} mutants, ", end="")
0528:         print(
0529:               f"{sum(1 for m in chosen if done[m.target['address']] and done[m.target['address']][-1]['mutant'] == m.what and done[m.target['address']][-1]['outcome'] == 'killed')} killed", flush=True)
0530: 
0531:     unchanged = evidence.input_digest(db) == tested_inputs
0532:     for f in targets:
0533:         rows = done.get(f["address"], [])
0534:         tried = [r for r in rows if r["outcome"] != "error"]
0535:         killed = sum(r["outcome"] == "killed" for r in tried)
0536:         results.setdefault(f["address"], {}).update(
0537:             name=f["demangled"], tried=len(tried), killed=killed,
0538:             score=round(killed / len(tried), 2) if tried else None,
0539:             strong=unchanged and mutation_strength(rows), mutants=rows,
0540:             mutation_classes=sorted({r["category"] for r in tried}), baseline_stats=base.get(covering(f)[0]),
0541:             code_at_test=tested_builds.get(f["address"], {}).get("code"))
0542:         build = tested_builds.get(f["address"], {})
0543:         if unchanged and build.get("object_digest"):
0544:             results[f["address"]]["evidence"] = evidence.tested(build["object_digest"], tested_inputs, parameters)
0545:     if not unchanged:
0546:         print("inputs changed during mutation testing; results are diagnostic only and cannot be recorded")
0547:     RESULT.write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
0548:     if args.accept and not args.hand:
0549:         record(db, functions, results)
0550:     strong = [a for a, r in results.items() if r.get("strong")]
0551:     print(f"\n{len(strong)} of {len(targets)} tests are strong (kill >= {STRONG:.0%} of mutants)")
0552:     for address, r in sorted(results.items()):
0553:         if "error" in r and "tried" not in r:
0554:             print(f"  {address} {db['functions'][address]['demangled'][:50]}: {r['error']}")
0555:             continue
0556:         print(f"  {address} {r['name'][:50]:50} {r['killed']}/{r['tried']}")
0557:         for row in r["mutants"]:
0558:             if row["outcome"] == "survived":
0559:                 print(f"      survived {row['mutant']}")
0560:     shutil.rmtree(WORK / "probe", ignore_errors=True)
0561: 
0562: 
0563: if __name__ == "__main__":
0564:     main()
